title: 国务院关于印发新一代人工智能发展规划的通知

policy_extraction.issuing_body: State Council of the People's Republic of China (国务院)
covered_actors: Provincial, autonomous region, and municipal people's governments (各省、自治区、直辖市人民政府)
Ministries, commissions, and directly affiliated institutions of the State Council (国务院各部委、各直属机构)
AI enterprises, leading backbone enterprises, SMEs, and startups
Industry associations, alliances, and AI think tanks
AI product R&D and design personnel

evidence.quote: 增强风险意识，重视风险评估和防控，强化前瞻预防和约束引导，近期重点关注对就业的影响，远期重点考虑对社会伦理的影响，确保把人工智能发展规制在安全可控范围内。
evidence.quote_en: Enhance risk awareness, attach importance to risk assessment and prevention and control, strengthen forward-looking prevention and constraint guidance, focus on the impact on employment in the near term and on social ethics in the long term, and ensure that AI development is regulated within a safe and controllable scope.

evidence.quote: 加强人工智能对国家安全和保密领域影响的研究与评估，完善人、技、物、管配套的安全防护体系，构建人工智能安全监测预警机制。
evidence.quote_en: Strengthen research and assessment of the impact of AI on national security and confidentiality fields, improve supporting security protection systems covering personnel, technology, physical assets, and management, and build an AI security monitoring and early warning mechanism.

evidence.quote: 构建动态的人工智能研发应用评估评价机制，围绕人工智能设计、产品和系统的复杂性、风险性、不确定性、可解释性、潜在经济影响等问题，开发系统性的测试方法和指标体系，建设跨领域的人工智能测试平台，推动人工智能安全认证，评估人工智能产品和系统的关键性能。
evidence.quote_en: Build a dynamic evaluation and assessment mechanism for AI R&D and application; develop systematic testing methods and indicator systems addressing the complexity, risk, uncertainty, explainability, and potential economic impact of AI designs, products, and systems; construct cross-domain AI testing platforms; promote AI safety certification; and evaluate the key performance of AI products and systems.

evidence.quote: 人工智能基础数据与安全检测平台。建设面向人工智能的公共数据资源库、标准测试数据集、云服务平台，建立人工智能算法与平台安全性测试模型及评估模型，研发人工智能算法与平台安全性测评工具集。
evidence.source_section: 专栏 3 基础支撑平台
evidence.quote_en: AI foundational data and security testing platform. Build public data resource repositories, standard test datasets, and cloud service platforms for AI; establish security testing models and evaluation models for AI algorithms and platforms; and develop security testing and evaluation toolkits for AI algorithms and platforms.

evidence.quote: 加强人工智能网络安全技术研发，强化人工智能产品和系统网络安全防护。
evidence.quote_en: Strengthen R&D on AI cybersecurity technologies and enhance cybersecurity protection for AI products and systems.

evidence.quote: 建立健全公开透明的人工智能监管体系，实行设计问责和应用监督并重的双层监管结构，实现对人工智能算法设计、产品开发和成果应用等的全流程监管。
evidence.quote_en: Establish and improve an open and transparent AI regulatory system, implement a two-tier regulatory structure emphasizing both design accountability and application supervision, and achieve full-process supervision over AI algorithm design, product development, and application of results.

evidence.quote: 促进人工智能行业和企业自律，切实加强管理，加大对数据滥用、侵犯个人隐私、违背道德伦理等行为的惩戒力度。
evidence.quote_en: Promote self-regulation in the AI industry and enterprises, earnestly strengthen management, and increase penalties for behaviors such as data abuse, infringement of personal privacy, and violation of moral ethics.

evidence.quote: 制定人工智能产品研发设计人员的道德规范和行为守则，加强对人工智能潜在危害与收益的评估，构建人工智能复杂场景下突发事件的解决方案。
evidence.quote_en: Formulate ethical norms and codes of conduct for AI product R&D and design personnel, strengthen the assessment of potential harms and benefits of AI, and build solutions for emergencies in complex AI scenarios.

enforcement_authorities: State Council of the People's Republic of China (国务院)
National Leading Group for Science and Technology System Reform and Innovation System Construction (国家科技体制改革和创新体系建设领导小组)
Ministry of Science and Technology (科技部)
AI Plan Promotion Office (人工智能规划推进办公室)
Inter-Ministerial Joint Conference on National Science and Technology Plan Management (国家科技计划管理部际联席会议)
compliance_deadlines: 2020: Strategic milestone to align overall AI technology and applications with world-advanced levels and preliminarily establish AI ethical norms and policies/regulations in selected fields
2025: Strategic milestone to preliminarily establish an AI legal, regulatory, ethical, and policy system and form AI safety assessment and control capabilities
2030: Strategic milestone to reach world-leading levels in AI overall and build a more comprehensive AI legal, regulatory, ethical, and policy system
policy_extraction.implementation_notes: Issued as State Council Notice Guo Fa [2017] No. 35 (dated 2017-07-08; published online 2017-07-20), this is China's overarching national AI strategy paper setting three-step targets for 2020, 2025, and 2030 rather than an enforceable statute. It directs ministries and local governments to implement R&D, industrial, military-civil fusion, infrastructure, and workforce tasks, coordinated by the National Leading Group for S&T System Reform and MOST (hosting the AI Plan Promotion Office) alongside an AI Strategic Advisory Committee. While it imposes no direct legal sanctions, Section 5 calls for future legislation on civil and criminal AI liability, sector-specific safety rules (e.g., autonomous driving, service robots), a dual-layer design-accountability and application-supervision regime, safety certification, and stronger penalties for data abuse, privacy infringement, and ethical violations.

risk_framing.rationale_summary: China's 2017 New Generation Artificial Intelligence Development Plan is dominantly framed around economic competitiveness: its preamble, strategic assessment, and three-step 2020/2025/2030 targets center on seizing first-mover advantage in global technological competition, upgrading domestic industry into the high end of global value chains, injecting new momentum into economic growth, and scaling core and related AI industries to over 1 trillion and 10 trillion RMB respectively. Economic competitiveness edges out the prominent runner-up, national security, because while national defense, strategic rivalry, and civil-military fusion are major co-justifications, the bulk of the document's operational goals, metrics, and industrial-policy architecture are oriented toward macroeconomic transformation and global commercial leadership. Social stability is a strong tertiary frame, portraying AI as indispensable for social governance, public security, and anticipating group psychology, while innovation enablement (coordinating development incentives with proportionate regulation) and labor transition (explicitly addressing near-term employment disruption and reskilling displaced workers) provide distinct supporting rationales alongside narrower mentions of privacy protection and consumer/public safety.

evidence_spans.quote: 为抢抓人工智能发展的重大战略机遇，构筑我国人工智能发展的先发优势，加快建设创新型国家和世界科技强国，按照党中央、国务院部署要求，制定本规划。
evidence_spans.source_section: 新一代人工智能发展规划
evidence_spans.quote_en: To seize the major strategic opportunity of artificial intelligence development, build our country's first-mover advantage in AI development, and accelerate the construction of an innovative country and a world science and technology power, this Plan is formulated in accordance with the deployments and requirements of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council.

evidence_spans.quote: 我国经济发展进入新常态，深化供给侧结构性改革任务非常艰巨，必须加快人工智能深度应用，培育壮大人工智能产业，为我国经济发展注入新动能。
evidence_spans.quote_en: China's economic development has entered a new normal, and the task of deepening supply-side structural reform is very arduous; we must accelerate the deep application of artificial intelligence, cultivate and expand the AI industry, and inject new momentum into China's economic development.

evidence_spans.quote: 当前，我国国家安全和国际竞争形势更加复杂，必须放眼全球，把人工智能发展放在国家战略层面系统布局、主动谋划，牢牢把握人工智能发展新阶段国际竞争的战略主动，打造竞争新优势、开拓发展新空间，有效保障国家安全。
evidence_spans.quote_en: Currently, China's national security and international competition situation is more complex; we must take a global perspective, systematically lay out and proactively plan AI development at the national strategic level, firmly grasp the strategic initiative in international competition in the new stage of AI development, forge new competitive advantages, open up new development space, and effectively safeguard national security.

evidence_spans.quote: 人工智能技术可准确感知、预测、预警基础设施和社会安全运行的重大态势，及时把握群体认知及心理变化，主动决策反应，将显著提高社会治理的能力和水平，对有效维护社会稳定具有不可替代的作用。
evidence_spans.quote_en: Artificial intelligence technology can accurately sense, predict, and provide early warning of major trends in infrastructure and social safety operations, grasp group cognition and psychological changes in a timely manner, and proactively make decisions and respond, which will significantly improve the capacity and level of social governance and play an irreplaceable role in effectively maintaining social stability.

evidence_spans.quote: 既要加大人工智能研发和应用力度，最大程度发挥人工智能潜力；又要预判人工智能的挑战，协调产业政策、创新政策与社会政策，实现激励发展与合理规制的协调，最大限度防范风险。
evidence_spans.quote_en: We must both step up AI R&D and application to maximize AI's potential, and anticipate AI's challenges, coordinating industrial, innovation, and social policies to harmonize incentivizing development with reasonable regulation and minimize risks.

evidence_spans.quote: 加强职工再就业培训和指导，确保从事简单重复性工作的劳动力和因人工智能失业的人员顺利转岗。
evidence_spans.quote_en: Strengthen re-employment training and guidance for workers to ensure that laborers engaged in simple repetitive work and personnel unemployed due to artificial intelligence smoothly transition to new positions.
